otherwise.en: Can otherwise normal, rational people, be turned into monsters, if placed in particular circumstances?
otherwise.zh: 原本正常、理性的人，如果被置于特定的环境中，会不会变成怪物？

otherwise.en: That feedback is essential. Otherwise, you might be repeating mistakes instead of improving.
otherwise.zh: 这种反馈至关重要。否则，你可能是在重复错误，而不是在进步。

otherwise.en: They do this to keep oil prices higher than they would be otherwise.
otherwise.zh: 他们这样做是为了使油价保持在比原本更高的水平。

otherwise.en: He was a young man, an otherwise well-behaved, upstanding member of society.
otherwise.zh: 他是个年轻人，平时行为端正，是社会上正派的一员。

otherwise.en: In the Arctic, dogs made human life possible in places that would otherwise have been completely uninhabitable.
otherwise.zh: 在北极，狗让人类在原本完全不适合居住的地方得以生存。
